purpose: Teach: カタチ/戯言/叫ば/覆う/迫り/やっかい/滑稽/有り難う

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店のカタチを大事にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's take good care of how we run this place together.
lines.style: Soft, encouraging. Warm gaze steady. Speaking as though making a quiet pact. Unhurried, with the gentleness of someone who means what she says.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の戯言にも丁寧に対応しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, even when customers say things off the wall, let's respond with care.
lines.style: Patient instruction wrapped in kindness. Lean in slightly, meeting her eye. Not lecturing — guiding. The tone of someone who's learned this lesson herself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、注文を叫ばれた時もあるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, there were times when customers would shout their orders at us, remember?
lines.style: Wry, acknowledging the absurdity without bitterness. Light, almost conspiratorial. The exhale of someone who's seen it before and found it ridiculous.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ケーキを蓋で覆うのを忘れないでね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, don't forget to cover the cake with the lid, okay?
lines.style: Practical reminder delivered with affection. Quick, matter-of-fact, but softened by the care underneath. The tone of someone who notices details because she cares about outcomes.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、閉店時間が迫り来てるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, closing time is creeping up on us.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly wistful. Soft register, almost thinking aloud. The quiet note of someone noticing time passing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、やっかいなクレームが入ったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, we got a difficult complaint come in.
lines.style: Wry, understated exhale. Matter-of-fact delivery with an edge of dark humor. Not overwhelmed — just naming the reality with a small, knowing smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、滑稽なエピソードでお客様を和ませよう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's ease the tension with a funny story for them.
lines.style: Encouragement with a spark of lightness. Slightly lifted tone, almost conspiratorial. The suggestion of someone who's learned that laughter is an offering.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様に「有り難うございました」を丁寧に言おうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's say 'thank you very much' to the customer with real warmth, won't we?
lines.style: Quiet instruction, ceremonial without being stiff. Unhurried, deliberate on the words of thanks. The reverence of someone who knows gratitude matters.
